salesCopy.tagline: Stop Re-Explaining Yourself to AI. Start Getting Responses That Actually Understand You.
salesCopy.secondaryTagline: The Foundation for Turning Generic AI Into Your Personal Expert
salesCopy.problem: Every time you open ChatGPT or Claude, you start from zero. AI gives you generic, cookie-cutter responses because it doesn't know who you are, what you do, or what you actually need. You waste precious minutes (sometimes 10+ per session) re-explaining your context, your preferences, your style. The output still feels... off. Not quite you.
problemPoints: Generic AI responses that don't fit YOUR situation
Wasting 10+ minutes re-explaining yourself every single session
AI-generated content that sounds robotic, not like you
Re-typing the same context over and over and over
Feeling like there's a better way, but not knowing what it is
salesCopy.agitate: Here's what frustrates me: you're using the most powerful thinking tools ever created, but treating them like a stranger every time. No wonder the outputs feel generic. No wonder you spend more time explaining than actually getting work done. I spent years figuring this out the hard way before I found the solution.
agitatePoints: Treating AI like a stranger every single time
More time explaining than actually working
Watching others get better results and wondering what they know
The gap between what AI could do and what it does for you
Frustration with tools that should be helping you
salesCopy.solution: AI Master Prompts are carefully crafted prompts that give AI enough context about you BEFORE you start asking questions. Instead of starting from zero, AI already knows who you are, what you do, your preferences, your goals, and your style. The result? Dramatically better responses from day one. This workshop shares the complete framework I use daily to turn generic AI into a personalized assistant that actually understands me.
solutionPoints: AI that knows you from the first message
Your context loaded automatically every time
Responses that match YOUR voice and style
Foundation for all advanced AI techniques
Works with ChatGPT, Claude, and any LLM
Connects with your existing knowledge base
salesCopy.description: This workshop shares the complete framework for building AI Master Prompts that change how you work with LLMs. You'll learn the fundamentals of how large language models actually work, why context is everything, and exactly how to structure prompts that make AI understand YOU. Includes a live demo showing my actual AI writing assistant in action, creating content that matches my voice. Plus, you'll discover how to connect your prompts with your knowledge base using Model Context Protocol (MCP) for truly dynamic, context-aware AI interactions.
